verdict.rationale: LanceDB documents a public programmatic API through multi-language SDKs (Python, TypeScript, Rust) with concrete code for search, filtering, table mutation, indexing and embeddings. Remote Enterprise tables authenticate with API keys that work in every SDK, and an llms.txt index is published for machine consumption. missing for 10: no published OpenAPI/REST spec (all probed paths 404), no independent hands-on corroboration of API usability (one community comment calls the docs poorly written).
